title: 20yo Slams Into Cop With Kidnapped Baby
description:

Brenton Howland, 20 years old, was charged with felony fleeing resulting in a crash, domestic violence, and endangering the welfare of a child, along with multiple counts of wanton endangerment and other traffic-related offenses. His bond was set at $1 million. He was transported to UC Medical Center with non-life-threatening injuries. The two-month-old child was taken to the hospital and made a full recovery before being reunited with the mother. After the suspect crashed into the police cruiser, the impact pushed the cruiser into a Jeep. The victims inside the Jeep were checked by medics at the scene, but declined to be taken to the hospital. Sergeant Nagy, the officer involved in the crash, was also transported to the hospital for treatment and is now recovering at home at the time of this video being published. Brenton Howland is innocent and less proven guilty in a court of law.
